entries.german: verleiht dem Hanns Praittenstain das vordere Schloss zu Praittenstain, das Halsgericht und den Wildbann "und was er sust zu lehen hat."
entries.english: Enfeoffs Hanns Praittenstain with the outer castle at Praittenstain, the high court, and the wild-bann, “and whatever else he otherwise holds as a fief.”
